entries.description: Deterministic IUAM challenge page: first <script> computes jschl-answer through the same JS primitives cloudflare.lua's generated preamble wires (btoa = Duktape.enc('base64'), atob = Duktape.dec — the fixture decodes via Duktape.dec('base64') directly; the preamble's atob path depends on TextDecoder which neither real Duktape nor the node:vm heap provides, see docs/evidence-antibot-integration.md). The <form id="challenge-form" action="/cdn-cgi/l/chk_jschl?__cf_chl_jschl_tk__=…"> and newline-prefixed self-closing <input name=/value=/> entries match cloudflare.lua's Lua pattern extraction exactly.

Webdriver-only block page (NO jschl form): served for /media/reload-* so cloudflare.lua solveChallenge() takes ONLY the FlareSolverr/webdriver branch (a jschl form here would let the IUAM branch overwrite the webdriver result — the reload-string flow needs result==2). Body carries both creatReloadStrings() markers so the reload branch flips Storage['reload'].
checkantibot.lua:5-12 signature matrix served by the mock server at /sig/* (9 shapes: 4 hit, 5 miss).
websitebypass_config.json default branch (use_webdriver=false) — the IUAM scenario config.
websitebypass_config.json webdriver branch (use_webdriver=true, loopback ip) — the FlareSolverr/reload scenario config; port materialized at test time.
FlareSolverr health body (parsed via CreateTXQuery json(*) XPathString) + solved-cookie solution returned by the stub-profile sidecar adapter.
